title: Extended symmetry of the Maxwell theory with a gauge coupling constant as a conserved charge
summary: It has been proposed that any coupling constant in a covariant action can be treated as a conserved charge by promoting the coupling constant to auxiliary fields, typically realized by a scalar field paired with a higher-form gauge field. However, the procedure may break local symmetries, which can be explicitly shown in a simpler setting such as Maxwell theory. The Hamiltonian analysis of Maxwell theory with the auxiliary fields reveals that some of the constraints are second-class. Applying the BFT formalism, we restore the broken local symmetries and obtain a fully symmetric action…
